_about: Wild Pathways sample map, Phase 1a. Hand-kept, NOT regenerated by the library sync, so it survives the nightly export. Keys are stay slugs; every entry carries the record's Ledger ID so it can be re-keyed to Base44 / Supabase properties.legacy_cms_id later. Pathway and volume relationships are editorial drafts for James's review; impact statements print only with a source, review date and status, and nothing here claims a figure the house has not seen.
